description: This file defines functions and types for creating and managing Discord clients, including configuration resolution, token handling, and request setup.

methods.name: createDiscordRuntimeAccountContext
methods.description: Creates a DiscordRuntimeAccountContext object with normalized accountId and provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveDiscordClientAccountContext
methods.description: Resolves the Discord client account context, including configuration, account info, and proxy fetch function.

methods.name: resolveToken
methods.description: Resolves the Discord bot token, throwing an error if missing.

methods.name: resolveDiscordProxyFetch
methods.description: Returns the proxy fetch function for Discord, based on the account context.

methods.name: resolveRest
methods.description: Resolves or creates a RequestClient for Discord API requests, using token and proxy fetch.

methods.name: resolveAccountWithoutToken
methods.description: Resolves a Discord account object without a token, merging configuration and checking enabled status.

methods.name: createDiscordRestClient
methods.description: Creates a Discord REST client with token, account info, and request setup.

methods.name: createDiscordClient
methods.description: Creates a full Discord client with request retry capabilities.

methods.name: resolveDiscordRest
methods.description: Resolves the REST request client for Discord.
